items.html:
(to the question) The HB of nursing
The phase of the light of Ruach, which ZA attains at the time of nursing, rejects the light of Nefesh of the pregnancy to the vessels of HGT, and is itself clothed in the vessels of HBD. And it is found that the phase of the HB of nursing is only the light of Ruach alone. And this is the rule: every new light that comes to the Partzuf is clothed in the upper vessels and rejects the light that was there previously to the vessels below. (Part 1, Page 154, Item 88).
